name: spe
description: Sistema de Pesquisa Eleitoral — monorepo (API, painel e aplicativo)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/painel install && npm --prefix apps/app install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/painel run lint && npm --prefix apps/app run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/painel run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/app run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/painel run build
